evidence.reason: The bug described (sorting `merged` including items that `continue` past `apply_measure`) is no longer present at the pinned tip. `cmd_measure` now builds a `measured` list (initialised at line 3501), appends only items that actually passed through `apply_measure` (lines 3505-3506), and sorts that `measured` list (line 3508). The print loop also iterates `ranked`, so the same skip path no longer reaches any `i["measure"]` access. The `KeyError` scenario the finding alleges cannot occur in the current implementation, so the defect is resolved.
